name: iframe
description: Display content from another web page in a frame.

actions.description: Load a new URL in the iframe.
Load a string of HTML content in the iframe. Enable sandbox if there is any untrusted content.

html.name: HTML
html.desc: A string of HTML content to load. Enable sandbox if there is any untrusted content.

url.name: URL
url.desc: The URL to load in the iframe.

html.name: HTML content
html.desc: A string of HTML to load in to the iframe. Only used if the URL is empty.

initially-visible.name: Initially visible
initially-visible.desc: Choose if the object is visible when the layout starts.

id.name: ID
id.desc: An optional ID for the control allowing it to be styled with CSS from the page HTML.

permissions.name: Permissions
permissions.desc: Settings controlling the permissions of the displayed page.

allow.name: Allow
allow.desc: An optional feature policy string for the 'allow' attribute, specifying what the displayed page is allowed to do.

enable-sandbox.name: Enable sandbox
enable-sandbox.desc: Enable the 'sandbox' attribute for enhanced security when displaying the page.

sandbox.name: Sandbox
sandbox.desc: The 'sandbox' attribute string with the list of sandboxing exceptions.
